purpose: German used-car listing wording intelligence for flipper/buyer-service decisions.
rules: Do not treat all defects equally.
Cheap cosmetic/comfort defects can be negotiation opportunity.
Engine, gearbox, documents, severe rust, overheating, heavy oil use and non-roadworthy wording destroy profit unless extremely cheap and verified.
Short or ugly descriptions are not automatic rejects, but they require direct seller questions.
Positive seller proof beats generic beauty words.

terms.risk: Engine work can destroy all margin.
terms.ask: Motorproblem genau erklaeren lassen, Video vom Kaltstart verlangen, normalerweise nicht kaufen.

terms.risk: Can be cheap sensor/battery, but can also be chain, injectors, compression or fuel system.
terms.ask: Video vom echten Kaltstart, OBD Fehlercodes, wann tritt es auf?

terms.risk: High oil use is a profit killer and hurts resale trust.
terms.ask: Wie viel Ã–l auf 1000 km? Bei mehr als minimalem Verbrauch nur mit extremer Preisreduktion.

terms.risk: Gearbox repair often costs more than the flip margin.
terms.ask: Probefahrt mit allen Gaengen, OBD, bei Automatik/DSG meist skippen.

terms.risk: Transport, unknown damage and no test drive create bad risk.
terms.ask: Warum nicht fahrbereit? Ohne klare billige Ursache normalerweise ablehnen.

terms.risk: Legal/document risk; resale can be impossible.
terms.ask: Nur mit klaren Papieren/Fahrzeugschein/Fahrzeugbrief.

terms.risk: Seller is basically warning that normal buyers should not buy it.
terms.ask: For this product strategy usually skip.

terms.risk: Can be cheap bodywork or structural/airbag risk. Profit depends on exact damage.

terms.risk: Seller may downplay damage; can still be okay if cosmetic and cheap.
terms.ask: Was genau wurde lackiert/getauscht? Fotos und Rechnung verlangen.

terms.risk: Structural rust kills TUV and resale.
terms.ask: Unterboden/Schweller Fotos und HU-Bericht; nur mit grosser Preisreduktion.

terms.risk: Can be acceptable on cheap liquid cars, but not if sills/underbody.
terms.ask: Rosttiefe, Schweller/Unterboden, Kotfluegel/Tuerkante separat pruefen.

terms.risk: Can be 50 EUR sensor or expensive emissions/safety fault. Needs OBD.

terms.risk: DPF/EGR/AdBlue can become expensive and hurts resale.
terms.ask: Fehlercodes, Langstrecke/Kurzstrecke, DPF/AGR Rechnungen.

terms.risk: Expensive diesel/petrol forced-induction repairs.
terms.ask: Leistung, Rauch, Fehlercodes, Rechnungen pruefen.

terms.risk: Can destroy engine if ignored.
terms.ask: Rechnung fuer Kette/Zahnriemen, Kaltstartgeraeusch, Intervall.

terms.risk: Acceptable only if price gap covers it.
terms.ask: Kupplungstest, Rechnung, Pedalpunkt, Geraeusche.

terms.risk: Can make cheap car worthless.
terms.ask: Usually skip unless confirmed cheap external leak.

terms.risk: Not automatic reject if very cheap, but TUV can reveal hidden repairs.
terms.ask: Warum kein HU? Alter HU-Bericht? Was muss fuer HU gemacht werden?

terms.risk: Strong resale confidence.
terms.ask: HU-Bericht zeigen lassen; Maengel im Bericht pruefen.

terms.risk: Improves trust and resale story.
terms.ask: Fotos von Rechnungen/Serviceheft.

terms.risk: Good if invoices exist; otherwise only seller claim.
terms.ask: Rechnungen/Fotos der Teile pruefen.

terms.risk: Strong for normal buyers and resale.
terms.ask: Fahrzeugbrief/Fahrzeugschein Besitzerhistorie pruefen.

terms.risk: Can be real opportunity, but also check if urgency hides technical issue.

terms.ask: Photos of defects, windshield crack size, TUV relevance.

terms.risk: Often acceptable on cheap liquid cars, but reduces resale and must be priced.
